title: Set-Valued Routing for Language-Model Agent Systems: A WildChat Benchmark and Cost-Aware Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2606.28925v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language-model agent systems must map natural-language requests to one or more specialized agents before planning or tool execution. This decision is often treated as top-1 selection, although compositional requests can require several capabilities and unnecessary dispatch raises cost. We formulate fixed-catalog routing as set-valued language understanding and construct a benchmark of 3,000 WildChat prompts over 12 capability-defined agents. Reproducible schema-guided reference sets are balanced by agent frequency and route cardinality. We compare profile retrieval, multilabel classifiers, a fine-tuned text encoder, and catalog-conditioned zero-shot GPT-4o. Evaluation combines set quality, latency, capability coverage, and ordinal-cost utility. The encoder attains 89.59 F1, compared with 71.79 for linear SVM and 41.51 for GPT-4o, and retains 88.02 F1 under a harder semantic-group split. We further introduce Weighted Agent Routi

translated_title: 面向语言模型智能体系统的集合值路由：一个WildChat基准与成本感知评估
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体系统必须在规划或工具执行之前，将自然语言请求映射到一个或多个专用智能体。这一决策通常被处理为top-1选择，然而组合式请求可能需要多种能力，而不必要的分发则会增加成本。我们将固定目录下的路由问题表述为集合值语言理解任务，并构建了一个包含3,000条WildChat提示、覆盖12个按能力定义的智能体的基准测试。可复现的模式引导参考集合按智能体频率和路由基数进行了平衡。我们比较了画像检索、多标签分类器、微调文本编码器以及基于目录条件化的零样本GPT-4o。评估综合考察了集合质量、延迟、能力覆盖率和序数成本效用。微调编码器达到了89.59 F1，相比之下线性SVM为71.79，GPT-4o仅为41.51，并且在更难的语义组划分下仍保持88.02 F1。我们进一步引入了加权智能体路由……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将语言模型智能体系统的路由从单一top-1选择扩展为集合值路由，构建了基于WildChat的3000条提示、12个能力定义智能体的新基准，并通过成本感知评估证明微调文本编码器（89.59 F1）显著优于线性SVM和零样本GPT-4o。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates routing in language-model agent systems as set-valued language understanding rather than top-1 selection, introduces a WildChat benchmark of 3,000 prompts over 12 capability-defined agents with cost-aware evaluation, and shows that a fine-tuned text encoder (89.59 F1) substantially outperforms linear SVM and zero-shot GPT-4o baselines.
